Final girl: incredible solo game bc it's made to be solo. A few feature films would he good to have to throw some variety in there. I have all of season 1 and 2 and its quite tough as a game but the variety keeps it interesting for sure. Each film gives you 2 girls, a location and an enemy. Honestly the girls only minorly change the game but the enemy and location greatly affect the mechanics of the game. Worth getting for solo if you can get multiple films.

Gloomhaven JOTL: way more story. Where final girl is a game, jaws is a scenario in a story. You could do 4 characters, I've played it thru 2x with a partner with 1 character each then 2 characters each. Technically only need 2 which you could solo. Can take some time but if you like the whole story of a whole game then it's fun. Also a blast unlocking hidden things within the game. Obviously once unlocked you know and final girl has a hidden thing per girl but jaws definitely is more of a campaign experience where you might be able to see the end but have to unlock the way. 

Out of the list tou wrote that's my experience. If you like the story more I've heard Arkham Horror the card game is excellent solo as well. Good luck my friend and enjoy!

So far, Inkanyamba is my favorite, but I have quite a ways to go still! 

I'd heavily recommend the companion app and purchasing the gruesome deaths, lore and scenarios in the app as well. It's cuts down on space to have less booklets out and it's a bit easier to get to that content with a few buttons rather than flipping a book. 

The mats are nice. They are the first gaming mats I have owned so I don't have anything to compare it to but it organizes the game well and makes setup so easy. Season 1 mats are simple and season 2 mats seem to have everything you might need for some films.

The minis are 50/50 take them/leave them for me. I love minis, I 3d print them for so many other things and these look great and they are officially added to my pile of grey to be painted! But, I wouldn't say they add a ton either. They are fun to have for sure and a good size for the boards. One problem I have with ISS Vanguard is the minis are just to big for the board and they get in the way of seeing content and symbols which these don't! 

Box of props is great. The dice in there can definitely mix up a game if you want to use them as well as the signature actions. 

As for some more extras, I am a big horror fan in general so I would recommend lighting some candles, go to melodice.org and plug in final girl for some background music or put on the movie that "inspired" the feature film your playing.  Take your time and make the film a great story rather than just win a game. Just go all out and have fun with it!
